title: Four-Point Discharge Clearance and Exit Protocol

steps.description: Consultant enters digital discharge order and drafts discharge summary with follow-up instructions.
Ward nurse verifies vitals stability, removes indwelling lines/catheters, and marks nursing clearance as TRUE.
Inpatient pharmacy conducts medicine reconciliation, dispenses take-home medicines, and marks pharmacy clearance as TRUE.
Central billing audits final consumables, obtains final TPA approval for cashless patients or processes cash settlement, and marks billing clearance as TRUE.
Medical Records Department (MRD) checks coding completion, archive status, and marks mrd clearance as TRUE to print patient gate pass.

common_blockers: Billing clearance blocked due to pending unbilled pharmacy consumables or unposted diagnostic tests
TPA final approval query pending regarding length of stay justification
Delay in consultant signing final typed discharge summary
